limitations: Only the original signed 256D BC01 lexical cue and narrative content features were tested. Trained familiar literal cues are not independent semantic queries. The neural inference receives only a cue string and a sparse learned synaptic overlay; memory event IDs/rankings and all targets reside in an EXTERNAL oracle-only evaluator, not the model. Staged training shows interference under a constant 317-event oracle candidate pool; it is not a claim of biological fly episodic memory. The rewired null exactly matches eligible binary in/out degree and edge-slot count, not every output neuron's contact-weighted incoming strength or final learned weight density.
